summary: Try-on flow: start + poll /status/. Key fix: catch AbortError in checkImageTryOnStatus so polls don't crash the route.

flow: 2. POST /api/v1/tryon        → ML POST /api/virtual-try-on/ → { prediction_id }  (up to 90s for cold start)
Client polls step 3 every 3s until status=succeeded

latest_fix.problem: {error: 'This operation was aborted'} — AbortController killed request before ML responded
causes: startVirtualTryOn had 30s timeout but Render cold start takes 30-60s → abort at 30s
getTryonStatus had 15s timeout — if Render was briefly slow, abort killed it
AbortError in checkImageTryOnStatus was uncaught → threw 500 error to client → polling showed error instead of continuing
fixes: mlFetch now retries on AbortError (up to 2 retries) before throwing
AbortError wrapped in human-readable message instead of raw 'This operation was aborted'
checkImageTryOnStatus catches ALL errors and returns {status:'processing'} so client keeps polling instead of crashing
Test page now shows detailed live log for every HTTP call and response

timeout_settings.startVirtualTryOn: 90s (POST to start ML job — Render cold start can be 60s)
timeout_settings.getTryonStatus: 30s (GET /status/ — instant when warm, 10-20s if Render just woke)
timeout_settings.mlFetch retries: up to 2 retries on AbortError and TypeError, 2s delay between

field_mapping.ML backend returns: TransformResponse { id, status, output, error, model_used }

what_we_send.garm_img: Cloudinary URL of product/garment image from DB

what_ml_expects.params: IDMVTONParams { garment_des, category, mask_img, crop, force_dc, mask_only, steps, seed } ✓

ml_backend_payload.verdict: Payload matches schema. ML POST returns prediction_id successfully.

how_to_debug: 1. Open /test page, run try-on, watch the Live Log panel
2. Log shows every HTTP call with status code and response body
3. Also check Next.js server console for [tryon] and [ml-client] lines
4. If Poll shows 'Status check failed: ML backend timed out' → Render is slow, keep waiting
5. If Poll shows status=processing for 4+ min → ML model may be stuck, check Render logs
